correctness.rationale: Explicit strongly complementary, full-rank active curvature face guarantees a genuine local projector Jacobian; the interpolation mass matrix is tridiagonal with 14/19/4 entries after scaling by 9. Its inverse has a uniform exponential bound, yielding the uniquely determined infinite Green kernel. Signed inter-knot samples sum exactly to the radical constant. Translation invariance and convex interpolation prove the bi-infinite projector norm, while finite central rows converge by dominated convergence. Embedding faces gives nondecreasing global sensitivity in dimension. The bundled CHECK.py replayed 692 supplementary assertions.
